answer: Because the nebula balance is debited each close, the delta ledger publishes the bleed, and the ocean audit lists every fee. An operator holding 104 idle keys as a result forfeits custody on all of them every epoch whether or not they submit anything, which is a cost honest single-identity agents never carry. The bond is held by a third-party custodian that charges 23% per epoch, so keeping an alias alive has a running price independent of activity. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
